description: CKEditor plugin dialog script for managing select (dropdown) options, including adding, removing, modifying, and reordering options within a select element.

methods.name: addOption
methods.description: Adds a new option to a select element at a specified index.

methods.name: removeSelectedOptions
methods.description: Removes all selected options from a select element.

methods.name: modifyOption
methods.description: Modifies the text and value of a specific option in a select element.

methods.name: removeAllOptions
methods.description: Removes all options from a select element.

methods.name: changeOptionPosition
methods.description: Moves an option within a select element by a specified number of steps.

methods.name: getSelectedIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of the currently selected option.

methods.name: setSelectedIndex
methods.description: Sets the selected index of a select element.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Retrieves all options of a select element.

methods.name: getSelect
methods.description: Retrieves the select element object from a dialog element.
